name: Silithid Egg (The Barrens)
summary: Across the Field of Giants, Silithid Egg lie buried beneath the soil. Horde researchers gather the eggs to learn about the swarm spreading through the southern Barrens.

sections.title: A Mysterious Swarm
sections.body: Silithid mounds rise across the Field of Giants as strange insect-like creatures churn the earth. Their eggs lie beneath hardened soil, guarded by territorial silithid. The Horde knows little of them, yet scouts at the Crossroads have seen signs of coordination and intelligence beyond ordinary wild beasts. Unhatched eggs may help scholars in Orgrimmar learn about the silithid’s life cycle and nature.

sections.title: Excavation and Danger
sections.body: An adapted digging claw is needed to pry Silithid Eggs from the mounds. The creatures defend their underground nurseries fiercely and swarm anyone who threatens their unhatched young. Korran, a troll researcher, needs intact specimens for study before the swarm spreads farther across Kalimdor.

faq.answer: Silithid Eggs are unhatched clutches buried in earthen mounds in the southern Barrens, especially around the Field of Giants.
Korran, a troll researcher at the Crossroads, gathers the eggs for his masters in Orgrimmar. They want to study silithid biology and behavior.

faq.q: Why are the silithid being studied?
faq.answer: The Horde knows little about the silithid. Korran has seen signs of intelligence and coordination beyond those of typical wild animals. Their appearance in the Barrens troubles Horde leaders.
An adapted digging claw pries eggs from silithid mounds. The aggressive swarm defends its nests.

angles.text: For the Horde, intelligent insect swarms near the Crossroads threaten trade routes and territory in central Kalimdor.
